integrity: All proofs and computations are included; finite checks corroborate but do not certify the universal theorem. No independent audit or publication-level novelty certification. The Fiedler (1990) publication is evidenced at year precision only; 2005-09-02 is the oldest verified exact calendar day for included primary sources.
scientific_limitations: Finite positive-edge spider trees with at least three nonempty arms, strictly positive vertex probabilities and real Hilbert targets. Does not cover branching arms, arbitrary Banach targets or arbitrary signed measures. General Hilbert infinite-dimensional validity follows from finite increment Gram matrices. Equivalent unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Planar optimality and radial rigidity for Hilbert-valued Lipschitz variance on weighted spider trees
